package.name: caddy_ai2_ros2_description
package.description: Robot description package for the Caddy AI2 agricultural vehicle. Provides the URDF Jinja2 template, physical parameters (robot_params.yaml), chassis mesh and a display launch for RViz visualization. Single source of truth for robot geometry shared across all other packages.
